name: JE_IT_INVOICES_E_LISTING
description: This table contains the electronic listing process information for invoices, that generates XML files for submission to the government of Italy. This table also contains file transmission information received from the revenue agency for declarations submitted in final mode.

columns.name: E_LISTING_ID
columns.description: Record identifier that is associated with the e-invoices declaration.

columns.name: VAT_REPORTING_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Tax reporting entity for which the extract is run.

columns.name: TAX_CALENDAR_NAME
columns.description: Calendar used for tax reporting.

columns.name: YEAR_OF_ELISTING
columns.description: Name of the year for which data is extracted.

columns.name: PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the declaration period.

columns.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the declaration period.

columns.name: SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Source of the transaction. For example, sales or purchase transaction.

columns.name: TRANSMISSION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transmission type of declaration. Valid values are 0  for original, and 1 for cancellation.

columns.name: PROGRESSIVE_TRANSMISSION_NUM
columns.description: Internal progressive transmission number used by the transmitter to identify the file transmitted in final mode. This is submitted to the tax authority.

columns.name: FILE_TRANSMISSION_NUM
columns.description: External declaration number. This number is received from the tax authority as part of acknowledgement of the electronic file transmitted to them.

columns.name: REPORT_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Extraction mode of the report. Valid values are D for draft and F for final.

columns.name: LATEST_RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the declaration record is the latest one. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
